source.method: Original pages 58,116-123 visually read; hand-transcribed conditions frozen before implementation.

clauses.quote: 動旺相而化旺相乘勢而進一也
動休囚而化休囚待時而進二也
動爻變爻有一而值休囚亦待旺相之日而進者三也
動爻變爻有一而值空破待填實之日而進者四也
動旺相而化旺相或有日月動爻生扶占近事得時而不退者一也
動休囚而化休囚及時而退者二也
動爻變爻有一而旺相待休囚之時而退者三也
有一而逢空破待填實之日而退者四也
酉金發動雖則休囚動而能尅旺相之卯木
clauses.implication: Same-element transformation is not independent proof of strength; seasonal weakness does not imply zero outgoing effect.

textual_issues.action: Keep raw prior transcription; use named scan reading for the four-clause profile.

scope: Progression condition branches, no total-strength vote, no event success judgment, no inferred horizon or recovered civil year. Same chart under different horizons is one structure, not independent validation samples.
